messages:
ella - design: uploaded a new guided 'Create API Key' flow. main goals: reduce cognitive load for newcomers and make keyboard-only path smooth. figma: https://figma.com/file/newcreatekey

omar - eng: quick note: keyboard shortcuts are doable, but we need clear focus states for each step. current mock hides focus outline on the key preview which is bad.

tess - ux: agree. also suggest a compact help tooltip next to 'Permissions' explaining scopes (read, write, manage). many users pick write when they meant read.

kai - product: can we show a sample policy link so admins see what 'manage' entails? also request flow: if a user lacks key.create, show a request button that opens a modal pre-filled with org and reason.

ella - design: will add request button. for empty state after revoke, proposed copy: 'No keys yet — create a credential to get started' with a subtle checklist toggle below (roles, rotation policy, audit logs). keep checklist collapsed.

omar - eng: API snippet request: include minimal create example for infra teams:

```
POST /v1/keys
{ "name":"service-worker", "scopes":["read"], "rotation_policy":"30d" }
```

tess - ux: accessibility nit: success banner should use aria-live=polite for non-blocking messages, but we need assertive for permission errors. also ensure the request-access modal is reachable by keyboard and announces itself with role=dialog.

kai - product: copy tweak: change 'Create key' to 'Create API key' for clarity in product; also change success toast from 'Key created' to 'API key generated — copy now, this secret is only shown once.'

ella - design: will update visuals and add a 'copy secret' inline button with aria-label 'copy secret to clipboard' and visible focus state.

omar - eng: implement server-side TTL for displayed secret; front-end will mask after 30s unless user opts to keep visible. track in audit logs.

tess - ux: last UX ask: add microcopy under 'Rotation policy' explaining consequences and a 'Quick set' dropdown: 30d/90d/manual.

kai - product: timeline: need final copy + keyboard tests by Friday. tagging infra for API snippet review after design updates.

alerts-bot: reminder: design review scheduled Fri 10:00 UTC.
